Pitlane HQ for Android and iOS (beta).

Downloads for everyone: **https://pitlanehq.app/downloads** · What changed: https://pitlanehq.app/changelog/phones

### Files
- `PitlaneHQ-Android-<version>.apk`: install on Android. Until a release key is set up, uninstall the previous version first.
- `PitlaneHQ-Android-<version>.aab`: for Google Play.
- `PitlaneHQ-iOS-<version>-unsigned.ipa`: sign it with your Apple ID to install (SideStore, AltStore or Sideloadly).
